title: Make the name plaque legible and gold
where: north portico, over the doors: signs at x=12 and x=14, y=8, z=8 (facing north) on the quartz board x11..15,y8,z9
instruction: In build.mjs section 5 (plaque) re-issue the two B.sign calls with { facing:'north', color:'orange', glow:true }; keep the text 'TRIBUNAL' / 'HOUSE' and 'HEARD' / 'HERE'. Re-run `node build.mjs`, then mcd paint, and check street.png that the lettering reads from the foot of the steps.

title: Hang two banners in the portico
where: portico back wall (z=10 face), x=8 and x=18, y=5..6, hanging at z=9 facing north
instruction: Add put(8,6,9,B.banner('white',[['border','gray'],['circle','black']],{facing:'north'})) and the same at x=18 (courthouse seal). Make sure the block at (x,6,10) is solid wall (it is stone brick). Check the street view; remove if they hide the window bays.

title: Make the pediment seal read
where: north pediment tympanum, x=11..15, y=12..15, z=3
instruction: The scales emblem is small and shadowed by the raking verge. Edit build.mjs section 7: make the panel x=10..16 (frame polished_andesite, interior smooth_quartz), keep y=12..15, and recolour the beam/post to polished_deepslate; add gold: set(13,15,3,'gold_block') as a finial above the beam if the cell is free. Re-render street.png and front-elevation.png.

title: Texture the roof slopes
where: roof, both slopes (east and west), x=0..26, y=12..18
instruction: Re-run the roof() call in build.mjs with pattern:{material:'andesite',every:5,offset:2} (banded courses) and hips untouched, keep material 'stone_brick', pitch 0.42 (height must stay <= 19). Compare with `mcd compare` and keep the better one.

title: Weathered base on the flanks and rear
where: east, west and south faces, y=0..4 (ground row)
instruction: Add to rules.txt under each FACE: `rows 0-3 -> weather 0.5` and `rows 0-3 where deepslate_bricks -> vary 0.2 cracked_deepslate_bricks`. Re-run mcd paint stage1.nbt build.nbt --rules rules.txt --face north,south,east,west,roof. Cracked and mossy, not gloomy.

title: Lamps on the side pilaster caps
where: west x=0 and east x=26, pilaster caps at z=11, 15, 19 (y=10)
instruction: In build.mjs section 7b, on top of each pilaster cap (y=11) add B.fence('oak') at (xo,11,z) and B.lantern(false) at (xo,12,z) for z in [11,19]. Stay inside x 0..26 and height <= 19; re-render left/right-elevation.png.

title: Flower planters beside the steps
where: foot of the steps, x=2 and x=24, z=2, y=1..2
instruction: Currently barrel + oak_leaves. Replace the leaves with set(x,1,2,'azalea_leaves',{persistent:'true'}) and add a flower_pot-style accent: set(x,2,2,'potted_red_tulip') on top. Also add set(4,3,6,'potted_azalea_bush') and set(22,3,6,'potted_azalea_bush') in the portico corners.

title: Rear gable window readable
instruction: The deepslate frame with iron bars and one glass pane is hidden in shadow. Edit build.mjs: frame in polished_andesite instead of deepslate_bricks, replace the iron_bars at x=12,14 with glass_pane, and add set(13,16,21,'deepslate_brick_slab',{type:'bottom'}) above as a hood.

title: Clean quartz kick-plate under the east gallery windows
where: east face, y=3..4 under the gallery windows at z=13..14 and z=17..18
instruction: Add to rules.txt under FACE east: a rule `east row 3 cols <columns of the two windows from mcd faces> -> smooth_quartz_slab top` for a clean kick-plate, plus `east row 6 col <gap between the windows> -> attach lantern`. Operators only clean street-level stone; leave the upper wall weathered. Re-run mcd paint and mcd compare, keep the better.
